title: Foundation Trust Deed
summary: Establishing trust deed for Bhavya Foundation as a non-profit institutional entity. Mandates radical transparency, vendor independence, and immutable decision logging.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: To establish an enduring institutional foundation that serves humanity and the natural world across generations.

sections.heading: Principles
sections.body: Radical transparency, vendor and provider agnosticism, immutable institutional memory, direct impact routing.
